exception_text: The borrower did not sign the 1003 mortgage application.
supporting_evidence: Approved resolution: Request the missing borrower signature on the application. Synthetic reviewer note: The application packet was received and the required borrower signature field was blank. The reviewer compared the signature checklist with the application certification page and confirmed there was no signature image or electronic signing record attached. No other application values were changed. The approved next step was to contact the processing team and request the completed signature page before continuing document review.

exception_text: The executed note is missing the borrower's signature.
supporting_evidence: Approved resolution: Request the missing borrower signature on the note. Synthetic reviewer note: The note copy was present, but the borrower execution line was empty. The closing checklist did not contain an alternate signed copy. The reviewer verified the file inventory and documented which signature page was absent. The approved next step was to request the signed note page from the responsible document source. The note terms were not altered.

exception_text: The income verification document is missing from the file.
supporting_evidence: Approved resolution: Request the missing income verification document. Synthetic reviewer note: The case checklist required current income evidence, but no supporting income document was present in the received package. The reviewer checked the incoming document inventory and confirmed the item was not merely filed under another label. The approved next step was to request the missing evidence. No income amount was inferred from other records.

exception_text: The paystub for the most recent month was not included with the loan packet.
supporting_evidence: Approved resolution: Request the missing recent paystub for income verification. Synthetic reviewer note: Earlier income paperwork was available, but the checklist called for a more recent paystub and the latest period was absent. The reviewer compared the periods shown in the synthetic file inventory. The approved next step was to request the missing recent paystub, then have a reviewer compare it with the existing income documents. No value was estimated.

exception_text: The property address on the appraisal conflicts with the deed record.
supporting_evidence: Approved resolution: Propose a field correction to align the appraisal address with the deed record. Synthetic reviewer note: The appraisal and deed record showed different property address values in a synthetic training case. The reviewer cited both source fields and did not assume which source was authoritative without confirmation. The approved next step was to propose a correction for reviewer verification against the governing property record. Do not silently overwrite either address.

exception_text: The mailing address on the form does not match the address in the title report.
supporting_evidence: Approved resolution: Propose a field correction to align the mailing address with the title record. Synthetic reviewer note: The mailing address field and title report address differed in a synthetic example. The reviewer recorded each source value and flagged the discrepancy instead of choosing one without evidence. The approved next step was to propose a field correction for human verification against the authoritative record. Confirm whether the values represent mailing versus property addresses before changing any field.

exception_text: The authorization request was missing the supporting clinical note required by the configured checklist.
supporting_evidence: Synthetic checklist records the clinical note as not received; resolution is to request the missing document.

exception_text: The post-service claim did not include the itemized hospital bill listed in the required-document checklist.
supporting_evidence: Synthetic checklist shows the itemized bill was absent; resolution is to request it.

exception_text: The policyholder name on the authorization request differed from the name on the synthetic policy record.
supporting_evidence: The two synthetic sources disagree on the policyholder name; resolution proposes a correction only after source verification.

exception_text: The policy number on the claim form differed from the policy number on the synthetic insurance certificate.
supporting_evidence: Synthetic claim form and certificate contain different policy identifiers; a reviewer verified the authoritative value before correction.

exception_text: The supporting medical report contained terminology that the standard extraction rules could not interpret reliably.
supporting_evidence: Synthetic extraction output left a key term unresolved; the case was routed to a qualified reviewer.

exception_text: The claim contained potentially altered invoices and inconsistent billing totals that required human investigation.
supporting_evidence: Synthetic records showed inconsistent invoice totals; automation abstained and referred the case for human investigation without asserting fraud as fact.
